current.text: He has a partially torn Achilles, found during surgery in May. He is out now (Yahoo status O).
Experts disagree on his return date. One expects him back at some point in November, the newest note expects a Christmas return.
He was traded to the Clippers in the Kawhi Leonard trade and takes Kawhi's spot.
When healthy he is likely the Clippers' number one option. He and Darius Garland should do nearly everything on offense, and his usage should rise from 26.7% and might approach 30%.
His assists may not rise with Garland running the offense.

Because of the Achilles injury he is now a late-round pick: not top 100, but fine around 100 to 110 in stash-friendly formats. He is the biggest fade on the Clippers, and experts are not drafting him.
The Clippers play 4-3-4 games in our playoff weeks (season ending March 28) and have one of the lowest back-to-back totals in the league with 13.
The Clippers do not control their own pick, so tanking does not help them. Their motivation this season is unclear, and they have one of the worst rosters.

durable.text: His games played over five seasons were 55, 45, 64, 18 and 77, while his minutes stayed between 32.9 and 34.2.
He is injury prone and a notoriously slow healer. His games played swing so widely that they are hard to project.
He is one of the better midrange scorers in the league. He needs a lot of the ball and is useless playing off the ball.
He rarely takes threes, has never committed to higher three-point volume and has sometimes struggled with three-point percentage.
He is an average defender at best with poor defensive stats.
Points are his best category. Turnovers are his weak category, at about 2.7 per game, which is high for his position.

note: The latest expert call puts him outside the top 100, around 100 to 110 in stash leagues. Our 4 IL slots make him a fair late stash for a few dollars, close to his Yahoo and ESPN average costs of 3.2 and 4.4 USD, not his Yahoo value of 16 USD or the 16 USD our league paid last season. He suits punt TO builds, and the Clippers have a 4-3-4 playoff schedule. Early on, watch his Achilles recovery (November or Christmas), because he heals slowly and his games played have ranged from 18 to 77.
